strings.name: Annika Sörenstam
strings.summary: Annika Sörenstam became a standard in women’s golf through consistent ball-striking and sustained winning: 72 LPGA titles, including ten majors. In 2003 she completed the career Grand Slam and played a men’s PGA Tour event. After leaving the full-time tour in 2008, she focused on family, her foundation and selected tournaments while encouraging girls’ golf.
